name: persona-in-domain
description: A persona as it appears in one domain: its goals, jobs and needs there. Refines the shared persona; the domain is given by an in-domain relation.

aiGuidance.purpose: One persona's goals, jobs and needs within one domain. Problems are held by it (held-by); its domain is the target of exactly one in-domain relation; it refines the shared persona (refines), which stays reusable across domains.
aiGuidance.extraction: Keep it short: title, a two-sentence summary, three to five goals, three to five jobs, brief needs. No long generated profiles.
aiGuidance.negativeGuidance: Do not name the domain in a text field; link it with in-domain.
